usedFor: flowyteam tracks key results, and Bolna places a call with “Make a Phone Call” when one goes off track.

bestTemplate.name: “New Off-Track Key Result” in flowyteam, then “Make a Phone Call” in Bolna
bestTemplate.why: A key result slipping off track starts a Bolna phone call, so the owner hears about it quickly.

watchOut: A call goes out each time “New Off-Track Key Result” fires, so keep the “Make a Phone Call” recipient internal.
